params.topic: La Liga 2018/19 exact football bookmaker odds gap recovery for 39 stable fixtures
questions: For each of the 39 exact stable_match_keys, find row-level, publicly verifiable football odds evidence for Bet365 1X2 closing (home/draw/away), William Hill 1X2 closing (home/draw/away), Bet365 O/U 2.5 earliest available pre-match or early snapshot and closing (over/under), and Pinnacle O/U 2.5 earliest available pre-match or early snapshot and closing (over/under).

Keep each bookmaker and market separate. Match by season, local match date, canonical home team, canonical away team, and fixture URL or identifier. Return one record per stable_match_key and bookmaker/market, including value fields, source URL, final URL, retrieval time, field locator, and source hash when available.

Do not call any value true opening unless the source explicitly labels it opening. If the source only has an earliest pre-match, Friday/Tuesday pre-closing, live, or closing value, retain that exact semantic label. Closing values must remain separate from earliest_pre_match values. Do not infer missing odds from another bookmaker, aggregate odds, scores, standings, Qimen, or outcomes.

Preserve every target row even when no evidence is found. Use status values ok, partial, unavailable, blocked, or conflict with a reason. Report coverage counts by bookmaker and market, exact covered and uncovered stable_match_keys, duplicate/conflict counts, and an unresolved_queue.

This is an odds-only football evidence request. Do not provide or infer Qimen palaces, home/away palace mapping, F/I/G tokens, Miss 1, Miss 2, BTTS, total-goals outcomes, model directions, or structure conclusions. Do not write to any local database.
